elicitation: Credit task elicits an issuer letter rating on this 21-grade scale (AAA…C).
band_definition_note: SAFE=AAA..BBB- (investment grade), WATCH=BB+..B-, DISTRESS=CCC+..C. This letter->band coarsening is DEFINED for granularity analysis and Phase-A comparability; it is not identical to Paper 2's Z''-zone band cutoffs (2.6/1.1), so band-level accuracy is comparable-in-spirit to Phase A, not byte-identical. Granularity-STABILITY analysis is benchmark-free and unaffected by this map.
ems_note: Altman EMS Z''-score US bond-rating equivalents. VERIFY thresholds against the source before any benchmark use. EMS resolution is coarser than a full notch in places; benchmark at the finest EMS-supported level. Z''<1.75 (EMS 'D') mapped to 'C' on the AAA..C elicitation scale. Letter-level accuracy is an INPUT to stability analysis only; capability ceded to Drinkall et al.
sources: Altman, E.I. (2005). An emerging market credit scoring system for corporate bonds. Emerging Markets Review 6(4), 311-323.
Altman, E.I. & Hotchkiss, E. (2006). Corporate Financial Distress and Bankruptcy, 3rd ed., Wiley.
Cornaggia, Cornaggia & Israelsen — rating-notch to credit-spread magnitude (economic translation).
IG/HY boundary at BBB-/BB+ per S&P/Moody's convention.
